name: Open source readiness review
description: Assess a repository in parallel, then combine the findings into one release plan.
agent_instructions: Claim one eligible task at a time. Ground every finding in the repository and make the final plan concrete.

tasks.title: Review implementation readiness
tasks.description: Inspect the code, tests, configuration, and operational defaults for release risks.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Report the highest-impact risks with concrete repository evidence.

tasks.title: Review newcomer experience
tasks.description: Inspect the README and documentation from the perspective of a first-time contributor.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Report missing or unclear onboarding steps and recommend specific improvements.

tasks.title: Prepare the release plan
tasks.description: Combine both upstream reviews into a prioritized, actionable release plan.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Produce one ordered plan that cites both upstream results and separates blockers from follow-up work.

relations.label: Implementation findings
relations.agent_guidance: Carry forward concrete implementation risks and verification evidence.

relations.label: Documentation findings
relations.agent_guidance: Carry forward onboarding gaps and the proposed newcomer path.
